outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 220 pregnant patients divided into two groups: a control group with gestational age 37-40 weeks and a study group with gestational age >40 weeks.
finding: Post-term pregnancy is associated with both maternal complications (increased rates of cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and sepsis) and fetal complications (increased rates of intrapartam asphyxia, admission to NICU, and intrauterine fetal death).
